units.source_text: 我和荣吉看见马路对面堆放着许多捆矮竹，就议论说，这些矮竹做手杖正合适，便抢先一步站起身来。

en.t: Eikichi and I saw many bundles of short bamboo piled up across the road, and after saying that they would be just right for walking sticks, we hurried to our feet ahead of the others.

units.source_text: 舞女跑着赶上，拿来了一根比自己身子还高的粗竹子。

en.t: The dancing girl ran to catch up and brought back a thick bamboo pole taller than she was.
